topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class and introduces the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen Recognition and PRR Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infections and tissue damage through pattern recognition receptors and their intracellular signaling pathways.

topics.label: Leukocyte Recruitment, Trafficking, and Systemic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how sentinel cell activation directs immune cell migration into tissues and lymph nodes, as well as the pathological outcomes of runaway systemic inflammation.

topics.label: Resolution, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the immune system terminates acute inflammatory responses, coordinates tissue repair, and adapts to persistent stimuli through chronic inflammation and granuloma formation.

topics.label: Conclusion and Preview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and announces that the next lecture will cover the complement system.
